column1: # CLAIMS.tsv — the typed claim ledger (Q-296), first tranche: TR-12's headline figures.
# One row per published figure: the executive summary and abstract of reports/TR12_QUERY_PROGRAM.md
# and the captions of its five figures (section 2). Each row types the claim (the set it is over,
# the equivalence under which objects count as the same, its unit, its scope, its epistemic status)
# and ties it to two things it does not control: the published line (`source`), and a command that
# re-derives the figure from committed files (`evidence`, `key`, `artifact`).
# run by scripts/doc_gates.sh GATE 92 (`claim-ledger`). That script's header defines every column,
# the render vocabulary and the five checks (S source, E evidence, P premise, F flags, A artifacts).
# SCOPE RULE. A row whose scope is `conditional-on:<premise>` names, in `premise`, text that must
# stand in the SAME SENTENCE as the figure; printing the figure without it fails the ledger.
# RE-PINNING. `source` is FILE:LINE. An edit above a cited line moves it and the ledger goes red
# with the line(s) where the figure now is; update the line number here in the same commit.
# NOT COVERED YET (later tranches): the body of TR-12, every other report, the retracted-status
# rows, and the generated CLAIM_TO_ARTIFACT.md. Absence of a figure from this file is not a claim
# that the figure is unchecked elsewhere.
